DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM

Between Elmwood Systems and Fabrikam Partners.

Section 4. Liability. Fabrikam's liability shall be unlimited for any breach of its data protection obligations under this addendum.

Signed. Signature: Jordan Ellis, Fabrikam. Signature: Taylor Brooks, Elmwood.

evidence.quote: Fabrikam's liability shall be unlimited for any breach of its data protection obligations under this addendum.

expected.rationale: Liability is expressly unlimited for data-protection breach. Signed, no change-of-control language, so only uncapped_liability applies.
